locked_nose.note: conditional local art acceptance only; exact #312 geometry, never regenerated

lids.inner: skin vertices coincident with EyeWhite (rim junction loop)
lids.ring_note: three concentric loops between the rim junction (t=0) and the outer boundary (t=1); same vertex count as the rim -> quads; zipper to the outer boundary

mouth.inner: skin vertices coincident with FaceMouth (lip seam ring)
mouth.ring_note: four concentric loops (lip seam, lip edge, lip outer, orbicularis outer) between the lip seam and the outer boundary
mouth.notch_note: no growth: the lip band (faces fully inside the ellipse) is already star-shaped; growing reaches the locked nose patch and breaks star-shapedness

cards.note: per state (Basis and every shape key) only opaque-texel samples buried under front-facing skin (front ray within 3 mm) are lifted along the covering skin normal by depth + clearance, least-norm distributed to the card triangle vertices; no blanket offset

eyes.oblique_cover_note: margin grows by (rim depth in front of the surface) x tan(60 deg) so +/-45 deg and 30 deg up/down views do not see past the surface edge
eyes.canonical_iris_aspect_status: ESTIMATED (lids clip the drawn iris; circle assumed)
eyes.pupil_frac_note: measured on Layer 0 front per side (1 px uncertainty, asymmetry kept as measured, unresolved)
eyes.colour_note: violet per canon (紫眼) and the 3D target close-up; values are evaluation colours, not a locked palette
eyes.surface_radius_note: 0.022 m (eyeball-like) let 45 deg views look past the far edge into the head interior (106-159 rays per eye); swept 0.03/0.045/0.07 -> 0.07 m is the first with 0 show-through in all 7 socket views. Flatter surface, closer to the VRoid plate curvature.
eyes.edge_cover_rule: edge is extended by the oblique cover but clipped where the opaque front skin stops covering it (no eye surface outside the head)

acceptance_technical_note: relative to the #312 baseline at nose depth 0.5; margins are provisional technical values, never art tolerances

retopo_status.reason: both evaluated configurations (polar rings, relax 0 / relax 5) create folds absent from the original mesh near the inner eye corner and mouth corners (see trial_annulus_retopo_04.py evidence)
retopo_status.next: switch method: corner-aware manual/sculpt retopology of lids and lips in Blender (or a constrained quad-remesh) reviewed by an artist; not auto-generated loops
